Cost year 2025: management services ($1,261,666) are paid to "Church Homes, Inc. Congregational, 217", whose name matches the home's CMS-enrolled legal entity (CHURCH HOMES, INC. CONGREGATIONAL). This can mean a parent or home-office charge; the cost report alone does not say what the fee covers.
No current ownership-interest records are listed for this home in CMS All Owners (common for nonprofits, which list directors and officers instead). Confirm the licensee with DPH.
